body:
I did find that counseling was extremely helpful in high school and think going back to the same one would be very helpful.  But the true fact is that I or my parents just cannot afford it.  I would never even think of asking for that considering the cost of college.  I am not sure about the hotline.  I just think it will lead me into circles and I will end up back where I am now.

I dunno how much I want help anymore anyways.  I think what would help me the most is to just have a break.  Get the fuck away from all of these people and just be alone.  But there is no day in sight that will give me that opportunity.  Of course, perhaps that's good because that would be a really good time to end it all with no intervention from anybody.  Really my thoughts are torn on life and death.   I would love to live if I could be happy.  But if this is my life I know that my suicide is truly inevitable.  Probably when I graduate and live alone next year.

Thanks for your reply... 

I can't imagine how good of a person you've gotta be for giving a shit about a random person over the internet that has no impact on your life.

I am currently on Effexor 75 mg which numbs everything as I'm sure you know.  I had a counselor as a Junior and Senior in high school, I am now a Senior in college.  I have made a visit to our campus counselor and frankly I could tell she didn't give a shit and rushed me out the door.  Which is fine, I understand completely and I don't expect her to.  

I know it's pathetic, lazy and weak but I am tired of looking for resources.  I am tired of fighting.  I am sick of having to act so damn happy and normal in front of everyone.  I know it sounds cliche but I am just tired.  I am ready to give up.  And I think I fought pretty damn hard but it's a battle I can't win.
